title: Bound NPC rescues (Goblin, Mechanic, Wizard, Stylist, Golfer, Angler, Tavernkeep, Tortured Soul) in Core
player_outcome: Some NPCs have to be found and freed before they move in, as in Terraria: a bound Goblin Tinkerer in the caverns after the Goblin Army, a bound Mechanic in the Dungeon after Skeletron, a bound Wizard in the hardmode caverns, a webbed Stylist in a spider nest, a Golfer in the underground desert, a sleeping Angler on the beach, an unconscious Tavernkeep after the evil boss, and a Tortured Soul in the underworld that must be purified to become the Tax Collector. Talking to them frees them.
design: TownNpcParts.cs: add RescueInfo { TypedSpec[] Requires (world conditions for appearing), TypedSpec[] Where (conditions judged at a candidate cell), string? Landmark (use a planned landmark if the dungeon phase adds one), string Pose (bound|sleeping|webbed|unconscious|tortured), string Title ('Bound Goblin'), string? RequiresItem (purification_powder), string Thanks, float MinDistance = 30, float MaxDistance = 70 }. Add TownNpcDef.Rescue.

New Gameplay/Town/SiteFinder.cs (reused by P5-19). TryFind(Where, player, rng, budget) → Int3? node. If Where names a zone biome that belongs to plan Features (spider_nest, dungeon), sample inside those features' Bounds near the player. Otherwise sample a shell of MinDistance..MaxDistance m around the player. Accept a candidate only if its chunk is loaded (GetBlock != Unknown), the Where conditions hold on ContextAt(cell), a humanoid can stand there (NearestStandable r=6), and the player cannot see it (!Npcs.InSight(player.Eye, center)). At most 8 candidates per call.

New TownSystem.Rescues.cs. UpdateRescues() runs every 120 ticks: for each def with Rescue, while the 'rescued_<id>' flag is unset, the NPC is absent and Requires holds, try SiteFinder and create the TownNpc with Bound = true. Rescue(TownNpc npc, PlayerEntity p, out string msg): when RequiresItem is set, it needs and consumes one of that item, otherwise it refuses with msg. On success it sets the flag through Progression.Set, clears Bound, sets Activity Idle and raises Rescued. The NPC is now a homeless resident, and CheckArrivals houses them.

Bound behaviour: TickResident skips Decide/Steer and only applies gravity. TakeContactHits and Damage ignore bound NPCs (invulnerable). BeginTalk is still allowed. TownNpc.DisplayTitle = Bound ? Rescue.Title : Title.
Persistence: Bound is already in ResidentModel from P5-01. A bound NPC lost to an unloaded save simply re-spawns later.
Commands in TownDebugCommands: 'town bind <id> [dx dy dz]' places a bound NPC ignoring Requires/Where; 'town rescue <id>'. TownProbes: town.<id>.bound.

New item purification_powder (material + Dryad shop entry in P5-15; 'bottled' Blender generator; reference entry). Tortured Soul: the tax_collector rescue has pose 'tortured' and requiresItem purification_powder.

ContentValidator.Town (split out ContentValidator.TownRescue.cs): check rescue specs, the item ref, the landmark id and the Pose enum. A 'rescued' condition on an NPC without a rescue block is now an error.

RescueTests.TorturedSoulNeedsPowder: refused without the powder; succeeds and consumes 1 with it

In game: 'flag defeated_goblin_army', walk into the caverns → a bound goblin appears off-screen within about a minute
risks: Rare zones (spider nests) may never be near the player; sampling inside plan features fixes this. The finder should also run when the player enters the zone ('zone.*' probe).
The dungeon/boss phase may also add a bound Mechanic. Agree that P5-06 owns the rescue system and the dungeon phase only adds a landmark.
tools/blender/assets.json is also edited by the art phase, so merge conflicts are likely.
